lead: An oversized allocation refuses differently under `try.py` than under `nvs test`.
body: A scratch `Core\Random::bytes(9223372036854775807)` run through `python tools/try.py` dies as `FATAL: the request exceeded its memory limit`, while the same line inside a `tests/conformance/` case throws the allocator's own catchable `…is larger than any buffer this process could hold` — the two runners hand the request different ceilings, and the scratch pad's answer is the wrong one to freeze into an `--EXPECT--`. Author the row wherever you like, then run it with `target/debug/nvs test <case>.nvst` before believing what it printed.
